WITH filtered_sales AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_order_number,
        cs.cs_item_sk,
        cs.cs_sales_price,
        d.d_date,
        i.i_item_id,
        w.w_state
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN item i ON i.i_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
    JOIN date_dim d ON d.d_date_sk = cs.cs_sold_date_sk
    JOIN warehouse w ON w.w_warehouse_sk = cs.cs_warehouse_sk
    WHERE i.i_current_price BETWEEN 0.99 AND 1.49
      AND d.d_date BETWEEN CAST('2001-04-02' AS DATE) AND CAST('2001-06-01' AS DATE)
)
SELECT
    fs.w_state,
    fs.i_item_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(fs.d_date AS DATE) < CAST('2001-05-02' AS DATE)
             THEN fs.cs_sales_price - COALESCE(ret.refunded_cash, 0)
             ELSE 0 END) AS sales_before,
    SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(fs.d_date AS DATE) >= CAST('2001-05-02' AS DATE)
             THEN fs.cs_sales_price - COALESCE(ret.refunded_cash, 0)
             ELSE 0 END) AS sales_after
FROM filtered_sales fs
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT cr.cr_refunded_cash AS refunded_cash
    FROM catalog_returns cr
    WHERE cr.cr_order_number = fs.cs_order_number
      AND cr.cr_item_sk = fs.cs_item_sk
) ret ON true
GROUP BY fs.w_state, fs.i_item_id
ORDER BY fs.w_state, fs.i_item_id
LIMIT 100
